Learn how we protect your privacy
What is analyzed:\n• Full message context (locally on your device)\n• Intent and tone of your messages

What is NEVER stored:
• Your message text
• Recipient information
• App names
• Your real identity

What is sent to server:
• Anonymous counter (if you choose 'Send Anyway')
• Violation category (e.g., 'harassment')
• No identifying information
Please grant overlay permission to enable safety warnings
Harmful online communication may violate laws in your jurisdiction. Think before you send.

Online harassment may violate:
• Section 506 IPC (Criminal Intimidation) - India
• 18 U.S.C. § 875 (Interstate Communications) - USA
• Communications Act 2003, Section 127 - UK

Hate speech online may violate:
• Section 153A IPC (Promoting enmity) - India
• 18 U.S.C. § 249 (Hate Crimes) - USA
• Public Order Act 1986, Section 4A - UK

Making threats online may violate:
• Section 506 IPC (Criminal Intimidation) - India
• 18 U.S.C. § 875 (Interstate Communications) - USA
• Communications Act 2003 - UK

Sexual harassment online may violate:
• Section 354A IPC, IT Act Section 67 - India
• Title IX, State Sexual Harassment Laws - USA
• Sexual Offences Act 2003 - UK
⚠️ Disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. Laws vary by jurisdiction. Consult a licensed attorney for specific legal guidance.
